read.module_json: full node walk of module.json (all segments S1 to S8, END)
read.sim: sim/misconceived.md (used for S1, S3, S4, S6 and the report check); sim/misconceived.report.json (R9). No other sim/*.report.json exists.

gate_check: G3: every next target I checked resolves to a defined node; every non-END node has a forward or retry path. G4: buttons only, no typed input, no runtime model.

criterion_notes.R1: Probe before explanation almost everywhere (S1.tissue, S2.entry, S3.skin, S4.t_pair, S5.r1, S6.ls_p1). Explanations follow a miss or a correct pick. Recap and worked-case nodes (S1.triple, S3.staging_ok, S6.ls_w1, S6.ls_w2) tell, but they are few.
criterion_notes.R2: Most distractors are a named trap with a refutation and a repair. Gaps: S6.im_a option 'Imaging is skipped' is mapped to TR5 but is the opposite error (under-imaging); S3.closing option 'mammography and bone scan' carries two errors; S6.ls_p1 'radiotherapy first' and S8.male 'early menarche' are dominated; S7.p14 'chemoprevention' is a correct plan item used as a distractor with no trap.
criterion_notes.R3: All 12 objectives are taught or tested on every path, fast lanes included (S2 skip keeps O2 via S2.brca_q and S2.male_q; S6 skip keeps O9 via S6.ls_p2). O1 names 'site' (upper outer quadrant) in the objective and in report.json, but no node teaches or tests it.
criterion_notes.R4: Nodes are short and mostly one idea. Overloaded: S4.t_n_reveal (three ideas), S5.r1_e (three ideas), S5.r4_ok (three ideas plus a summary on a correct pick). The formula 'That choice is not right.' repeats across roughly 70 feedback nodes.
criterion_notes.R5: Hint ladder on most probes (hint, retry, reveal). Two fast lanes (S2.entry_ok skip, S6.ls_p1_ok skip). Second explanations use a different technique in S2 (contrast), S5 (contrast and ordering) and S6 (worked case). Confidence drives only sure_note text, not a branch.
criterion_notes.R6: Outdated PYQ keys (cervix, FNAC, Halsted, M1, dissect-first, dense-breast imaging) drilled in exam form, with the old key and current practice both named. Negative stems (NOT / one wrong statement) are drilled. Minus: O1 site is missing.
criterion_notes.R7: Decisions in vignettes with age, stage, menopausal status and nodal position. Well framed.
criterion_notes.R8: Warm and direct, with good bridging lines (S7.t_a 'name the default the stem is baiting'). Repetition ('That choice is not right.', 'Let us test that again from another angle' x3) dulls the voice on a 1 a.m. read.
criterion_notes.R9: Path: each trap has a named belief in its feedback, and the S8 cold probes (S8.axil, S8.numb, S8.tam, S8.male) have no hint, which tests unaided success. Losses: S6.im_a (TR5 mismapped), S7.p14 (partial with no belief), S7.p1 (the correct pick is the old key). Report (report.json, rendered in sim/misconceived.report.json): every objective 'shaky', so the list gives no priority; next_steps.gap says 'objectives marked gap' when none is; help.hints_heavy fires on 'Show me why' taps (hints 14, hints opened 0).

segments.reason: Strong hook: the learner fails the cervix key, the FNAC key and the TR17 age trap, then sees the reveal. Weak retest: S1.re4 restates the answer one node after S1.gate_reveal, so it is not delayed and tests the sentence, not a new case.
flaws: S1.re4: retest follows the reveal by one node and repeats the same sentence (sim friction, unchanged)
S1.gate_reveal: no site or subtype taught, so O1 'site' is never reached

segments.reason: Fast lane, contrast node and genes all sit on trap-map traps (TR10, TR8, TR9, TR12). numbers_pten and numbers_stk name the distractor gene and why it tempts. Patched: refutations are specific.
flaws: S2.entry_t10: sure_note says 'a common type is not the answer to a question about spread', but the stem asks about cell pattern (sim friction, unchanged)
S2.vign: probe has no hint option and no Sure prompt, so the lobular picture gets no ladder
S2.family_q: 'A: BRCA2; B: BRCA1' is labelled partial but is a full swap of two traps

segments.reason: Five traps, each with a belief-naming refutation (TR20, TR12, TR17, TR1, TR5). Thin probe at S3.imaging.
flaws: S3.closing: option 'Clinical examination, mammography and bone scan' is tagged TR5 but carries two errors (mammography and bone scan), so it diagnoses nothing
S3.imaging: only the correct pick and the TR17 trap, no partial, so the probe is easy to eliminate
S3.imaging_why: repeats S3.imaging_ok almost word for word (sim friction, unchanged)

segments.reason: Staging is well laddered: T pair, T which, T vignette, N, and the M1 contrast with the old key named. S4.t_n_both is a clean refutation.
flaws: S4.t_n_reveal: three ideas in one message (AJCC contralateral M1; older PYQ M1; same-side N3c) (sim friction, unchanged)

segments.reason: Patched well: S5.t2_t14 now says why step 2 is sound, which fixes the old friction. Axillary and nerve probes cover TR27, TR3, TR14, TR15 with contrasts.
flaws: S5.t4_nerve: 'One of these three statements is wrong' where the correct pick is the false statement, so a fast tap is easy to misread
S5.r4_ok: correct-pick feedback summarises three ideas (MRM, SLNB, nerves)
S5.t1_op, S5.t2_size, S5.t4_nerve: the same opener 'Let us test that again from another angle' (voice)

segments.reason: Sequence, drug choice, tamoxifen tissue action and LCIS are sound, each with a reasoning node and a repeat probe. Two distractors do not work as traps.
flaws: S6.im_a: option 'Imaging is skipped because she has no symptoms' is tagged TR5 but is the opposite error (under-imaging); the TR5 diagnosis is over-ordering
S6.ls_p1: partial 'Radiotherapy to the breast first' is dominated, so the probe offers one live distractor
S6.why_p: the 'Surgery is curative' trap body repeats S6.ls_show word for word (sim friction, unchanged)
S6.tt_p2: two options both tagged TR22 (neither drug / raloxifene raises risk); acceptable, but they test one belief twice

segments.reason: Trimmed from 14 probes to 10 and bridged by S7.t_a and S7.t_b, which helps. Still a drill of 'NOT' stems that re-ask traps seen earlier with the same options, and a tired learner can misread it.
flaws: S7.p1: 'Which statement is NOT correct?' where the correct pick is the old FNAC key, and its feedback opens 'Yes. That is the old key'; affirming the outdated belief on a negative stem is confusing
S7.p5: negative stem where both traps are true statements; one wrong option can be read as the answer if the learner misreads NOT
S7.p7, S7.p9, S7.p10, S7.p11: re-ask refuted traps (TR2, TR12/TR13, TR3, TR6/TR22) with the same options, so they test recognition, not a changed belief
S7.p14: partial 'Discussing chemoprevention options' is a correct plan item used as a distractor and maps to no trap, so picking it says nothing about the learner

segments.reason: Good cold consolidation: four probes with no hint (S8.axil, S8.numb, S8.tam, S8.male) test unaided success. Each misconception is paired with a one-line correction.
flaws: S8.male: partial 'Early menarche' is dominated (no one with surface knowledge picks a female hormonal factor for male cancer)
S8.axil: three options, two of them traps and no partial, so the wrong picks each diagnose a different error but the probe offers no near-miss between the key and the traps

best_parts: S4.t_n_both: names the old model (every node above the collarbone counted as distant), then points to the side of the node; a clean refutation with a repair.
S5.t2_t14 (patched): now explains why step 2 (downstage to 2 cm, then conserve) is sound, so the learner is not left guessing. Good repair for TR14.
S2.numbers_pten and S2.numbers_stk: each names the distractor gene, says why it tempts (Li-Fraumeni, ataxia-telangiectasia), and returns to the 17q arm.
flaws: S6.im_a: TR5 mapped to an under-imaging option (wrong error)
S3.closing: option with two errors mapped to one trap
S2.entry_t10: sure_note text about 'spread' for a pattern stem (old friction, unchanged)
S1.re4: delayed retest is not delayed and repeats the reveal
S7.p1: the correct NOT pick is the outdated key, with 'Yes. That is the old key' as feedback
S7.p14: distractor with no trap (chemoprevention)
S7.p7, S7.p9, S7.p10, S7.p11: re-ask refuted traps with the same options
S6.ls_p1 and S8.male: dominated partials

merge_ideas: Keep S7's bridging lines (S7.t_a, S7.t_b) and put them before S8 as the only drill; fold the re-asked traps into fresh vignettes rather than the same options.
Give S6.im_a a real TR5 distractor (routine bone scan for a stage I patient) and move the under-imaging option to a new probe tagged as its own trap.
Add a site probe (upper outer quadrant) to S2 after S2.contrast, so O1 is taught and tested on every path.
Use S4.t_n_both's refutation style for the S7.p7 and S3.closing repairs, which currently rely on a single sentence.

report_r9.misconceived: The path says clearly what the learner believes: twenty trap taps, all with Sure, all recovered, overconfident. The trap lines name the belief (e.g. 'You moved from the old FNAC key to core biopsy'), which is the most useful part of the report. But the report misleads on three points: the objective list says nothing (twelve 'shaky'), the gap instruction points at nothing, and the hints count is taken from 'Show me why' taps, not from hints. Recovery is credited only by recognition, and the report does not say so.

round_comparison: Round 0 (sim walk) flagged S7 drill, S5.t2_t14, S2.entry_t10, S4.t_n_reveal, S3.imaging_why, S6.why_show, S1.re4 and the report gap/hints issues. Round 1 patched S2, S5, S7 and S8. S5.t2_t14 and the S7 length are fixed; S2.entry_t10, S4.t_n_reveal, S3.imaging_why, S6.why_show and the report text are not. The round-1 gain is real but partial.
